title: check_typed_item_calls.py: Avoid repeatedly re-reading dissector files
description:
Also prefers 'in' operator over calling find() for a string.
Saves over 40s when scanning all dissectors with all options enabled.

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 50782a84 - check_typed_item_calls.py: Avoid repeatedly re-reading dissector files
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22099/diffs?diff_id=1544351072&start_sha=06b667cde52c1e176a9590cb0389896b108c63d9)
Oh dear, somehow this change actually slows things down (2m47s -> 3m04s)..

Also finding a different number of warnings..
- fixed
